Name: 4" x 18" DuraVent B Vent Round Rigid Pipe - 4GV18
Natural: Use for venting listed natural gas or liquid propane category I, draft hood appliances, or appliances that have been specifically tested and listed to use Type B Gas Vent. To calculate installed length, subtract 1 1/2" from each connection of vent. A 1" clearance (air space) to combustible materials must be maintained. To calculate OD add 5/8". Pipe length measures 4" Diameter x 18" Long.
